5.6.0.en:
Adapter requires node.js >= 22.19.0 now
Fixed: the announcement sound was overwritten by the following text, so external players (e.g. Squeezebox) said the text twice (#527)
Added the output type "WiiM / LinkPlay" for the streamers of the wiim adapter
Added the output type "Assistant satellites" for the voice satellites of the assistant adapter
Added the output type "Alexa" for the Echo devices of the alexa2 adapter
Added the output type "Bose SoundTouch" with the notification interface of the speaker, which resumes the playback
Added the output type "Kodi" for the kodi adapter
Added the output type "Asterisk (phone call)": the text is played in a phone call of the asterisk adapter
The configuration shows a hint for the output types, which do not restore the playback (Google Home, Kodi)

Ausgabetyp „Asterisk (Anruf)“ hinzugefügt: Der Text wird in einem Telefonanruf über den asterisk-Adapter abgespielt

desc.en: Text to speech in a cloud or local. Runs on windows, linux and OSX. It can play mp3/wav too.
